request.subject: UNIT:CULT:CAPTAIN

layers.text: Change only the dagger: the cyan glints at its hilt become dull gold, colour #c9a24a, and the blade becomes pale steel grey, colour #c8c8d0, with bright red blood, colour #d01818, running down it. Do not redraw anything else: keep the tall red cowl, the pale grey face, the red, black and gold robe, the chain, the thick black outline and the art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
